```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
source("../R/csquared-ggplot-theme.R")
source("../R/csquared-slide-charts.R")
sample_data <- data.frame(
  category = c("North", "South", "East", "West"),
  value = c(42, 31, 27, 18)
)
```

## Slide style

The slide stylesheet controls the background, typography, and accent colors.

The graph theme controls the figure itself.

## Highlighted bar chart

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10.7
#| fig-height: 4.4
#| fig-alt: "Sample horizontal bar chart highlighting North at 42."
csquared_highlight_bars(sample_data, "category", "value", "North",
                        x_title = "Example value")
```

<p class="small-note">Example values are illustrative.</p>
